content.body:
The Utilities Department provides water, sewer, stormwater and trash and recycling services. Customers pay for these services through a bimonthly bill.

**In case of emergency,** such as a water or sewer main break, call **720-898-7070**.

For**address changes or service transfers** please call customer service at 720-898-7070 (Monday through Friday 8 am to 5 pm). For **missed waste and recycling pick up** please call 720-898-7575. For additional utility bill questions, please reference the [Pay My Bill page](/453/Pay-My-Bill), submit a ticket through [Ask Arvada](/898) or [email us](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#0a7f7e63666b6e6763644a6b787c6b6e6b2465786d).

### Electricity & Natural Gas Services

Electricity and natural gas services in Arvada are provided by [Xcel Energy](https://www.xcelenergy.com/).

## Before you dig

**Important: Before doing any digging, you must call 811 to request locates of all public utilities.**

To initiate a request for underground utility locates, including sewer and water lines, contact Colorado811 at 811 or [visit their website](http://colorado811.org/).

### [Utility Line Locate FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=31)

[Do I have to be on-site?](#)
:   In most cases, homeowners and residents do not have to be on-site. Your underground utilities will be marked in the areas using the information you have given.

[Do I have to call even if I am not planning on digging deep?](#)
:   Colorado law requires that you make notification before you begin any size project from small ones, such as planting a tree or bush, to a big project such as pipe replacement or installation.

[Still have questions?](#)
:   [Ask for help or submit a request](https://seeclickfix.com/web_portal/m96AzqbgQ9RW9z5CcqFqEwP8/issues/map)
